minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved a small consulting set-aside with Wright Pierce and told staff to post the business manager job at 40 hours.
minutes.summary: The commission heard a developer's preliminary questions on sewer use at 1325 Mass Ave, mainly floor drains and an MDC trap in a contractor storage building. It also discussed grease trap inspections, Pond View, policy updates, the budget schedule and the business manager's retirement posting. A vote set money aside for a general consulting contract, and the meeting adjourned.

The business manager presented the monthly Fitchburg invoice and said it matched the provided figure; members were fine with it.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to set money aside for a general consulting contract with Wright Pierce; the motion passed.
The business manager's replacement job will be posted at 40 hours as is, with no formal vote; a flexible hours range is to be revisited later with the Personnel Committee.
Members signalled no objection to floor drains in each bay of a proposed contractor building at 1325 Mass Ave, routed to an MDC trap.
Sewer department will inspect Il Forno's internal grease traps and logs, with a consultant attending, before the outside pumping frequency is changed.
A draft sewer budget is expected before the January 31 meeting, and a special budget workshop may be held.

why_it_matters: The consulting set-aside and the Pond View engineering questions draw on sewer funds that residents on the system pay for through their sewer bills.
The sewer budget schedule and the business manager hiring decide who prepares and presents next year's sewer budget and rates, which residents on the system will be billed under.
watch_next: The commission's January 31 meeting, where a draft sewer budget is expected and a special budget workshop may be set.
The annual report due February 16, and the proposed policy updates members are to review before the next meeting.
